title: Pi reviewer receives its task after worker completion
description: Set FARMSLOT_GATEWAY and FARMSLOT_PI_REVIEW_PROOF_RUN_ID after replaying self-review. Reads the actual reviewer signal and checklist through the production gateway.

reviewer-progress.intent: Prove the worker remains complete and a separate Pi reviewer has executed its own checklist under its current attempt identity.

fix-handoff.intent: Prove reviewer findings reach a fresh Pi fix worker and advance its scoped checklist, without typing into the completed worker's composer.

recovered-completion.intent: Prove the gateway binds and settles the actual completed fix attempt after restart, even when it missed the running signal.

delivery-isolation.intent: Guard against a worker marker suppressing reviewers or retries; reject duplicate delivery within one session and permit retry after a submission error.
